Key Benefits
• Adds instant glow & radiance to any makeup look
• Lightweight, smooth & blendable formula
• Can be mixed with foundation or worn alone
• Provides a dewy, fresh-skin finish
• Enhances complexion without cakiness
• Suitable for all skin types

Mix 1–2 drops with your liquid foundation for a luminous, radiant finish.

Apply directly on cheekbones, nose bridge, cupid’s bow, and brow bones.

Use a thin layer alone for a natural glow on no-makeup days.
4. Blend Properly:
Use fingertips, a blending sponge, or a foundation brush for a smooth finish.

Crow's feet, dark circles, bags... It is clear that the skin around the eyes deserves special care. This is an area prone to dehydration, sagging or inflammation because it is extremely thin and elastic.
Therefore, it is important to use quickly penetrating cosmetic products and decongestants that help protect the area from aging and help maintain its moisture. But not everything goes. It is not at all advisable to use facial creams that are not specifically designed to treat the area, since, in addition to not being tested under ophthalmological control, they will not produce the expected benefits. On the other hand, starting on time is a good defense for the skin.
It is advisable to start treating the area from the age of 30, as this is the age at which collagen stops being produced at previous levels and the elasticity of the skin is compromised. In this way, it is important to use creams and serums with a cold effect to relax the inflammation of the bags, with micropigments or minerals with an anti-dark circle or firming effect that help provide more support fibers to this fine dermis. Finally, getting into the habit of wearing sunglasses, regularly going to the ophthalmologist or using products with photoprotection are actions that contribute to taking optimal care of the eye area and preventing its deterioration.
